title: App-aktivitet Queries
sourceNote: SQL från iLEAPP, ALEAPP och Sarah Edwards (APOLLO/mac4n6). Tiderna visas med datetime(..., 'unixepoch', 'localtime'). Kolumnnamnen är desamma som i databasen. Biome App.InFocus är inte SQLite — använd iLEAPP.

queries.title: /app/usage — app aktiv
queries.subtitle: Visar vilka appar som användes inom tidsspannet, med start, slut och antal sekunder. ZVALUESTRING är appens bundle-ID.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  datetime(ZOBJECT.ZSTARTDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZSTARTDATE,
  datetime(ZOBJECT.ZENDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZENDDATE,
  datetime(ZOBJECT.ZCREATIONDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZCREATIONDATE,
  ZOBJECT.ZVALUESTRING,
  (ZOBJECT.ZENDDATE - ZOBJECT.ZSTARTDATE) AS usage_seconds
FROM ZOBJECT
WHERE ZOBJECT.ZSTREAMNAME = '/app/usage'
  AND ZOBJECT.ZSTARTDATE BETWEEN {{cocoaStart}} AND {{cocoaEnd}}
  AND IFNULL(ZOBJECT.ZVALUESTRING, '') LIKE '%{{bundleId}}%'
ORDER BY ZOBJECT.ZSTARTDATE;

queries.title: /app/inFocus — förgrund (äldre iOS)
queries.subtitle: Visar vilken app som låg i förgrunden på skärmen inom tidsspannet. Saknas ofta från iOS 16, då finns uppgiften i Biome App.InFocus i stället.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  datetime(ZOBJECT.ZSTARTDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZSTARTDATE,
  datetime(ZOBJECT.ZENDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZENDDATE,
  datetime(ZOBJECT.ZCREATIONDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZCREATIONDATE,
  ZOBJECT.ZSTREAMNAME,
  ZOBJECT.ZVALUESTRING,
  (ZOBJECT.ZENDDATE - ZOBJECT.ZSTARTDATE) AS usage_seconds
FROM ZOBJECT
WHERE ZOBJECT.ZSTREAMNAME = '/app/inFocus'
  AND ZOBJECT.ZSTARTDATE BETWEEN {{cocoaStart}} AND {{cocoaEnd}}
  AND IFNULL(ZOBJECT.ZVALUESTRING, '') LIKE '%{{bundleId}}%'
ORDER BY ZOBJECT.ZSTARTDATE;

queries.title: /display/isBacklit — skärm tänd
queries.subtitle: Visar när skärmen tändes och släcktes inom tidsspannet. Jämför med app-aktiviteten för att se om någon tittade på telefonen.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  datetime(ZOBJECT.ZSTARTDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZSTARTDATE,
  datetime(ZOBJECT.ZENDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZENDDATE,
  datetime(ZOBJECT.ZCREATIONDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZCREATIONDATE,
  CASE ZOBJECT.ZVALUEINTEGER
    WHEN 0 THEN 'Backlight off'
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Backlight on'
    ELSE ZOBJECT.ZVALUEINTEGER
  END AS ZVALUEINTEGER
FROM ZOBJECT
WHERE ZOBJECT.ZSTREAMNAME = '/display/isBacklit'
  AND ZOBJECT.ZSTARTDATE BETWEEN {{cocoaStart}} AND {{cocoaEnd}}
ORDER BY ZOBJECT.ZSTARTDATE;

queries.title: /device/isLocked — låst/olåst
queries.subtitle: Visar när telefonen låstes och låstes upp inom tidsspannet.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  datetime(ZOBJECT.ZSTARTDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZSTARTDATE,
  datetime(ZOBJECT.ZENDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZENDDATE,
  datetime(ZOBJECT.ZCREATIONDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZCREATIONDATE,
  CASE ZOBJECT.ZVALUEINTEGER
    WHEN 0 THEN 'Unlocked'
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Locked'
    ELSE ZOBJECT.ZVALUEINTEGER
  END AS ZVALUEINTEGER
FROM ZOBJECT
WHERE ZOBJECT.ZSTREAMNAME = '/device/isLocked'
  AND ZOBJECT.ZSTARTDATE BETWEEN {{cocoaStart}} AND {{cocoaEnd}}
ORDER BY ZOBJECT.ZSTARTDATE;

queries.title: Hjälp: lista strömmarna i databasen
queries.subtitle: Söker inte efter händelser. Visar vilka strömmar (ZSTREAMNAME) som finns och hur många rader var och en har, så att du ser vilka queries som kan ge träffar.
queries.sql:
SELECT ZSTREAMNAME, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM ZOBJECT
GROUP BY ZSTREAMNAME
ORDER BY n DESC;

queries.title: Interaktioner per app + person
queries.subtitle: Visar kontakter med personer inom tidsspannet (meddelanden, samtal, delning) och vilken app som användes. ZBUNDLEID är appen.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  datetime(ZINTERACTIONS.ZSTARTDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZSTARTDATE,
  datetime(ZINTERACTIONS.ZENDDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZENDDATE,
  ZINTERACTIONS.ZBUNDLEID,
  ZCONTACTS.ZDISPLAYNAME,
  ZCONTACTS.ZIDENTIFIER,
  ZINTERACTIONS.ZDIRECTION,
  ZINTERACTIONS.ZISRESPONSE,
  ZINTERACTIONS.ZRECIPIENTCOUNT,
  datetime(ZINTERACTIONS.ZCREATIONDATE + 978307200, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS ZCREATIONDATE
FROM ZINTERACTIONS
LEFT JOIN ZCONTACTS ON ZINTERACTIONS.ZSENDER = ZCONTACTS.Z_PK
WHERE ZINTERACTIONS.ZSTARTDATE BETWEEN {{cocoaStart}} AND {{cocoaEnd}}
  AND IFNULL(ZINTERACTIONS.ZBUNDLEID, '') LIKE '%{{bundleId}}%'
ORDER BY ZINTERACTIONS.ZSTARTDATE;

queries.title: ACTIVITY_RESUMED — app i förgrund
queries.subtitle: Visar varje gång en app öppnades eller kom tillbaka till förgrunden inom tidsspannet (ACTIVITY_RESUMED).
queries.sql:
SELECT
  datetime(events.timestamp / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS timestamp,
  packages.package_name,
  CASE events.type
    WHEN 1 THEN 'ACTIVITY_RESUMED'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'ACTIVITY_PAUSED'
    WHEN 23 THEN 'ACTIVITY_STOPPED'
    ELSE events.type
  END AS type
FROM events
INNER JOIN packages ON events.package_id = packages._id
WHERE events.type = 1
  AND events.timestamp BETWEEN {{unixMsStart}} AND {{unixMsEnd}}
  AND IFNULL(packages.package_name, '') LIKE '%{{packageName}}%'
ORDER BY events.timestamp;

queries.title: Förgrunds-händelser (resumed/paused/stopped)
queries.subtitle: Visar när appar öppnades, pausades och stängdes inom tidsspannet, så att du kan se hur länge en app var aktiv.
queries.sql:
SELECT
  datetime(events.timestamp / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS timestamp,
  packages.package_name,
  CASE events.type
    WHEN 1 THEN 'ACTIVITY_RESUMED'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'ACTIVITY_PAUSED'
    WHEN 23 THEN 'ACTIVITY_STOPPED'
    ELSE events.type
  END AS type
FROM events
INNER JOIN packages ON events.package_id = packages._id
WHERE events.type IN (1, 2, 23)
  AND events.timestamp BETWEEN {{unixMsStart}} AND {{unixMsEnd}}
  AND IFNULL(packages.package_name, '') LIKE '%{{packageName}}%'
ORDER BY events.timestamp;
